posthoc_reverse_after_first_bar.note: added after the pre-registered results were seen (disclosed in the study record, 2026-11-02): sign of close(bar 8) / close(bar 1) against the first-bar sign, so the first bar no longer counts toward its own continuation

method.daily: XAUUSD_1d close-to-close; release day D vs non-release days and non-release Fridays; drift close(D+5)/close(D); bound = 1.96 x pooled SE
method.intraday: FX_IDC:XAUUSD 30m chart exports (Oct 2026 resampled from 15m); release bar opens 08:30 ET; 1h = close of 2nd bar, 4h = close of 8th bar, both vs release-bar open; baseline = same ET bar on non-release Fridays; whipsaw = first-bar sign differs from 4h sign

limitations: No payroll consensus or surprise data: 'good vs bad number' is not tested.
Daily series is the repository XAUUSD_1d, not TradingView; levels differ slightly.
Intraday sample is 32 releases (2024-01 onward); shares carry wide intervals.
Descriptive only; no trading rule is implied.
